releaseNotes.zh:
1. 修复 Windows 自动更新：重启更新按钮一直转圈的问题（双进程架构下主窗口未跟随退出）
2. 修复更新失败时无提示的问题，现在会显示失败原因
3. 更新脚本改为等待旧程序完全退出后再安装，避免文件占用导致安装失败
releaseNotes.en:
1. Fixed Windows auto-update: the restart-to-update button spun forever (the webview host did not follow the backend exit in the dual-process architecture)
2. Update failures now show the reason instead of a stuck spinner
3. The update script waits for the old app to fully exit before installing, avoiding file-lock failures
